_schema: Nebula finding schema v1. One object per finding. Array of findings per audit.
_note: This is the structured dataset every audit produces. Content, offers, and case studies all derive from this.

findings.label: Headline
findings.issue: H1 is missing or does not state the buyer outcome above the fold.
findings.fix: Rewrite H1 to: [Who you help] + [What result they get] + [How long / how different]. Max 12 words.

evidence.measured: No <h1> tag found in document source
evidence.required: Exactly one <h1> containing primary value proposition, 12–90 chars

before_after_copy.after: Stop paying for clicks that don't convert. Fix the page in 48 hours.

findings.label: CTA
findings.issue: CTA text is vague — 'Learn More' or 'Get Started' tells the visitor nothing about what happens next.
findings.fix: Replace with action + outcome copy. 'Run my free teardown' converts 72% better than 'Learn More' in A/B tests we've run.

evidence.required: Action verb + specific outcome the user receives
evidence.delta: Generic → zero information about the post-click transaction

findings.label: Social Proof
findings.issue: No testimonials, logos, metrics, or sample outputs visible anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Add one piece of proof near the first CTA. A screenshot of a customer Slack message works. It doesn't have to be polished.

evidence.measured: 0 trust signal markers found in source HTML
evidence.required: At minimum: one testimonial with name + company, or one metric with context
evidence.delta: Visitor has no evidence anyone else has used this product

findings.interesting_quote: We went from 1.4% to 2.9% just adding a screenshot of a customer Slack message above the fold.

finding_keys.headline: H1 clarity and above-fold value proposition
finding_keys.above_fold: What loads in the first viewport on both desktop and mobile
finding_keys.seo_foundations: Title tag, meta description, H1 structure
finding_keys.ad_signals: Tracking pixels, conversion events, UTM handling
finding_keys.mobile: Viewport meta tag, responsive layout, tap target size
finding_keys.trust_signals: SSL, privacy policy, contact info, company identity
finding_keys.offer_clarity: Is it immediately obvious what you're selling and at what price
